source: This means your rendered {0} declarations will typically have fewer {1} entries, reducing overall CSS size.
text: Das bedeutet, dass deine gerenderten {0}-Deklarationen in der Regel weniger {1}-Einträge enthalten, was die CSS-Gesamtgröße verringert.
